title: Align the workflow target guard with the native harness adapter
goal: Keep the workflow performance guard truthful after native workflow start replaced shell target seeding in the harness adapter

results.why: The guard required crates/susi-harness/src/adapter.rs to contain the retired shell seeder string, but the adapter now creates a private target through native workflow start.
results.change: The guard continues checking the shell session seeder and separately checks the adapter's native private-target contract: shared-link rejection and CARGO_TARGET_DIR rooted at the worktree.
results.tests: cargo fmt --all --check: exit 0; cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --test ci_workflow_perf -- --nocapture: 27 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored; cargo local-workflow check: format and clippy passed, 110 test binaries built, but host_only_privacy (2 tests) and peer_channel_hub (2 tests) failed under the six-lane runner; each binary passed alone (2/2) and together (2/2 each)

limitations: This changes only a source-shape guard; native adapter behavior remains covered by its adapter tests.
The current main test gate has a pre-existing parallel integration-test failure in host_only_privacy and peer_channel_hub; this task is not shippable until the gate is green.
